properties.name: FIELD REPORT (bhome S3, 2026-09-18): rev A showed the design fitting by counting 45 sq ft of stacking that 'budget_report does not model and has never counted' — MEASURED on a scratch design: `constrains` accepts a negative contribution (−20 against +90 rolled up to 70, verdict within), so reclaimed space CAN be modelled today; the report's premise is false and nothing told the reporter, because no description or skill says a contribution may be negative
properties.source: bhome feedback.md, Session 3 (2026-09-18), triaged 2026-09-19 through the triage-feedback skill
properties.statement: Reporter: only 20 of the 45 sq ft have a figure anywhere in the graph; the sheet now shows stacking 'as claimed and not counted'. MEASURED 2026-09-19 with target/debug: add_constraint limit 100, constrains +90 and −20 → budget_report total 70, within, both contributors listed. So the mechanism exists; the instruction leg does not — constrains' description speaks of a part's share of the quantity and never of a reclaiming (negative) contribution, and the optimize skill does not either. CAUSE: an unstated capability — the three-legs rule (typed tool + instruction + detector) with the instruction missing.
